label: Bible Study
prompt: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them _____.
verse: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
note: The Golden Rule, Luke's edition — do first, as you'd have done to you.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his _____ for the sheep.
verse: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
note: Hirelings run when the wolf comes; the good shepherd stays and pays with his life.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a _____; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verse: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
note: The Christmas verse: no room in the inn, so the King of kings got a feeding trough.

label: Deep Water
prompt: My people are destroyed for lack of _____: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verse: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
note: Hosea's diagnosis: Israel wasn't destroyed by armies but by ignorance they chose on purpose.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, _____ of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verse: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
note: 'Bowels of mercies' — the KJV locates compassion in the gut, which is honest anatomy.
